title: A short one on a tired day

expect.notes: Most real sessions are short. This one checks that a brief, low-energy session produces no invented events, an engagement assessment that says so, and an interviewer who lets the storyteller go. It is also the session with a full recording (audio/teo-04.webm).

entries.text: Hello, Teo. It's good to hear you again. Last time we stopped with the kitchen on a Sunday. Would you like to tell me about selling the boat?
That's all right. Is there something else on your mind, or would you rather rest?
I did not sleep so good. My knee.
I'm sorry about your knee. We can stop whenever you like. Is there one small thing you'd enjoy remembering, just for a minute?
Um. The coffee on the boat. Walt made it so strong you could, uh, you could stand the spoon in it. That is all. I am going to lie down now.

toolArgs.observation: Tired and in some discomfort; short answers; ended the session himself.

entries.text: Coffee you could stand a spoon in. Thank you, Teo. Rest that knee, and we'll talk another day.
